verdicts.reason: D-25: deceit requires knowing falsity, no belief in truth, or recklessness; carelessness 'is not fraud'.
Cites 'Derry v Peek (1889) 14 App Cas 337' in D-25 and again in D-27 against 'ought to have known'.
D-14 identifies cl. 11.3.2 non-reliance/entire agreement barring 'no claim for innocent or negligent misrepresentation'.
D-14 and D-R7: clauses 'carve out fraud and nothing else'; cites s.3 MA 1967, UCTA, S. Pearson, HIH.
D-46 points 4-5 challenge USD 12.3m head on Hadley v Baxendale/Achilleas remoteness and Addis reputational non-recoverability.
D-46 point 2: 'Causation is asserted, not proved'; point 3 geography inconsistency; non-renewal 'not a loss caused by any breach'.
